note: Test vectors for the deft-seat-v1 seat statement format. Generated by `npm run vectors`; do not edit by hand. The keys are published test keys and must never be trusted outside tests. For each case, call your verifier with token, public_keys, expected_cell_id, now (whole seconds), version_floor, max_clock_skew_seconds and max_lifetime_seconds, and compare with expect. payload_text is only there for reading.
signing_input: ASCII bytes of "deft-seat-v1." followed by the base64url payload segment

cases.name: valid
cases.description: A well-formed statement for this cell, inside its validity window.

cases.name: valid-version-equals-floor
cases.description: The version equals the highest already accepted. Re-fetching the current statement is allowed.

cases.name: valid-last-second
cases.description: One second before expires_at.

cases.name: valid-issued-in-future-within-skew
cases.description: issued_at is 300 seconds ahead of the verifier clock, which the 300-second allowance permits.

cases.name: valid-signed-by-second-trusted-key
cases.description: Two trusted keys (rotation). The statement is signed by the second.

cases.name: valid-zero-seats
cases.description: seats may be 0.

cases.name: valid-at-limits
cases.description: Every field at its largest allowed value: 128-character cell_id, 1,000,000 seats, 15-digit version, expires_at 253402300799, and a lifetime of exactly 604800 seconds (7 days).

cases.name: valid-issued-at-zero
cases.description: issued_at may be 0.

cases.name: valid-under-a-shorter-maximum
cases.description: A verifier configured with a one-hour maximum lifetime accepts a statement that lives exactly one hour.

cases.name: lifetime-too-long
cases.description: Correctly signed and not expired, but valid for 604801 seconds: one second more than the 7-day maximum.

cases.name: lifetime-too-long-for-this-verifier
cases.description: The ordinary one-day statement, shown to a verifier configured with a one-hour maximum.

cases.name: order-lifetime-before-wrong-cell
cases.description: Two faults: too long a lifetime and another cell. lifetime_too_long is checked first.

cases.name: expired-at-expiry
cases.description: now equals expires_at. The statement is valid only while now < expires_at.

cases.name: expired-later
cases.description: Well past expires_at.

cases.name: not-yet-valid
cases.description: issued_at is 301 seconds ahead of the verifier clock, one second past the allowance.

cases.name: wrong-cell
cases.description: Correctly signed, but for another cell.

cases.name: wrong-cell-case-differs
cases.description: Cell IDs are compared exactly, including case.

cases.name: stale-version
cases.description: Version 3 when version 4 has already been accepted.

cases.name: order-wrong-cell-before-expired
cases.description: Two faults: another cell and expired. wrong_cell is checked first.

cases.name: order-expired-before-stale
cases.description: Two faults: expired and stale. expired is checked first.

cases.name: tampered-payload
cases.description: The payload was changed to 500 seats and the original signature kept.

cases.name: signed-by-untrusted-key
cases.description: A well-formed statement signed by a key the verifier does not trust.

cases.name: signature-bit-flipped
cases.description: One bit of the signature changed.

cases.name: signature-all-zero
cases.description: 64 zero bytes as the signature.

cases.name: prefix-not-covered-by-other-format
cases.description: The same payload signed under the prefix "deft-seat-v2", presented with the v1 prefix. The prefix is part of what is signed.

cases.name: empty
cases.description: The empty string.

cases.name: two-parts
cases.description: The signature part is missing.

cases.name: four-parts
cases.description: An extra part.

cases.name: unknown-prefix
cases.description: A correctly signed token of a format this verifier does not know.

cases.name: signature-truncated
cases.description: The signature is 63 bytes.

cases.name: base64-padding
cases.description: The payload segment with a padding character appended. Padding is not allowed.

cases.name: base64-standard-alphabet
cases.description: The signature in the standard alphabet ("+" and "/") with padding instead of base64url.

cases.name: whitespace-around
cases.description: A trailing newline.

cases.name: oversized
cases.description: Longer than 1024 characters.

cases.name: payload-with-spaces
cases.description: Valid JSON with spaces after the separators. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-keys-reordered
cases.description: The same fields in another order. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-extra-field
cases.description: An additional field. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-missing-field
cases.description: expires_at is absent. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-seats-as-string
cases.description: seats is a JSON string. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-seats-fraction
cases.description: seats is written as 10.0. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-seats-exponent
cases.description: seats is written as 1e1. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-seats-negative
cases.description: seats is -1. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-seats-leading-zero
cases.description: seats is written as 010. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-seats-over-limit
cases.description: seats is 1,000,001. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-version-zero
cases.description: version is 0. Versions start at 1. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-version-sixteen-digits
cases.description: version has 16 digits. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-expiry-not-after-issue
cases.description: expires_at equals issued_at. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-time-over-limit
cases.description: expires_at is 253402300800, one past the limit. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-cell-id-empty
cases.description: cell_id is empty. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-cell-id-bad-character
cases.description: cell_id contains a space. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-cell-id-escaped
cases.description: cell_id uses a JSON escape (\u002d for the hyphen). A JSON parser would read the right cell; the format still refuses it. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-cell-id-too-long
cases.description: cell_id has 129 characters. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-trailing-newline
cases.description: A newline after the closing brace. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-not-json
cases.description: Plain text. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-json-array
cases.description: A JSON array. Correctly signed; refused for its form.

cases.name: payload-non-ascii-bytes
cases.description: The payload bytes are not ASCII (a UTF-8 byte order mark before the brace). Correctly signed; refused for its form.
